protocol: E8 per-lens nodes per frame + per-lens class MI before/after
scenes: dev split, lowest-rank dev instance per class, view -090-000 (8 scenes, 1 per class)
mi_discretisation_rule: Binary lens-presence per scene (present/absent) vs the 8-class label; MI in bits, computed as sum P(x,y) log2(P(x,y)/(P(x)P(y))) with P(class)=1/8 per scene. 8 scenes, 1 per class.

before.note: CONTOUR_PEAK, Contour, ContourFragment, Corner, CurveComplex, EndStopped, Orientation, PEAK_CHAIN, RegionShape are present in all 8 classes (MI=0). IllusoryContour in 5/8, Junction in 4/8.

after.arm: F (L3/L4 ON + sub-pixel peak positions + position-wiring fix)
after.per_lens_nodes: identical to before: the sub-pixel fix changes only the (x,y) of CONTOUR_PEAK tokens, not node counts or signatures. Verified: FE_SUBPIXEL_PEAK_POS adds x_sub/y_sub to the peak dict and refines the position written to anchor_positions; it does not add, remove, or re-signature any node.
after.position_wiring_fix_effect: BINDER_COMPLETE_POSITION_MAP=True + note_tier_positions merge makes CONTOUR_PEAK/PEAK_CHAIN/EndStopped/etc. nodes carry positions in anchor_of_node (was 0% for CONTOUR_PEAK before). This changes geometry available to the matcher, NOT node counts or class MI.

information_guard: No lens loses >30% of nodes or 0.1 bits class information; the fix is do-no-harm (adds positions, never removes nodes).
